metric.external_integration_coverage.candidate_universe: Preserved candidate universe and findings from certified legacy work unit ecosystem-tooling--part-5--java; recertification did not select a new language-specific target.

component_findings.c_native: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--java): Frozen 10-category rubric measuring breadth and reliability of working, actively-maintained external integrations (cloud SDKs, data/messaging systems, native interop, observability, serverless, build/CI ecosystem, API/RPC standards, container/orchestration, enterprise messaging standards, mobile-ecosystem reach), independent of language-level FFI design (scored under Language Quality). Each category worth 10 points; 10 if an official first-party SDK/client exists and is actively maintained, 5 if only community-maintained but widely adopted, 0 if no meaningful integration exists. Applied identically across the assigned language set.

metric.external_integration_coverage.limitations: Coverage is assessed via a fixed set of widely-recognized integration domains rather than an exhaustive inventory of every third-party library; presence of an official SDK does not by itself measure integration depth or feature completeness within each cloud/service surface.
metric.external_integration_coverage.selection_rule: Evaluate working documented integrations and binding ecosystems, not only theoretical FFI design; FFI language design itself belongs to Language Quality.

metric.implemented_platform_coverage.candidate_universe: Categories were fixed before evidence collection as a language-neutral set spanning desktop/server OSes, CPU architectures, mobile, web, embedded, and native-AOT deployment, applied unchanged across the assigned language set.

component_findings.architectures: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--java): GraalVM native image supported OS/arch combinations (Linux/macOS x86-64+ARM64, Windows x86-64)
component_findings.desktop_server_os: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--java): GraalVM native image supported OS/arch combinations (Linux/macOS x86-64+ARM64, Windows x86-64)
component_findings.embedded: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--java): Wide vendor support for embedded/ARM/RISC-V/PowerPC configurations via distributions such as Liberica JDK.
component_findings.mobile: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--java): GraalVM Native Image produces standalone platform-specific executables for the major desktop/server OS+arch combinations.
component_findings.web_wasm_other: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--java): No first-party OpenJDK Wasm target; only third-party/experimental transpilers exist.

metric.implemented_platform_coverage.limitations: This rubric samples a fixed category list rather than an exhaustive platform enumeration; some categories (e.g. mobile, embedded) are scored as binary YES/NO despite internal nuance (e.g. Android's ART runtime vs desktop HotSpot JVM).
metric.implemented_platform_coverage.selection_rule: Count only platforms with currently implemented and documented build/run support; design intent without working support does not count.

snapshot_recertification.policy: legacy evidence re-adjudicated under current runner-owned rubric
